हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/VpL54G
show.description: Kishan Nath, a frail 23-year-old ward attendant, lives as an abused burden in his ancestral home, poisoned and humiliated by his uncle Mukesh and aunt Vimla to keep him submissive. At the hospital, he bonds with a comatose old man he calls Baba—unaware it’s his grandfather Vishambhar Nath, presumed dead. With nurse Jagriti, Kishan uncovers a conspiracy to steal the Nath Empire and kill him.
